paite: Huchi in sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a;
heading: TOUPA'N Jerusalem Atungding Ding
english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

paite: "Hichibang in sepaihte! TOUPA'N achi: Thikthusetak in Zion ka deihthoh a, nakpitak a hehna toh amah a ding in phatuam ka ngai hi," chi in.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”

paite: Hichibang in TOUPA'N achi: Zion ah kiksak in ka om a, Jerusalem lai ah ka teng ding; Jerusalem bel Thutak khopi, sepaihte' TOUPA tang, tang siangthou akichi ding hi.
english: Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of Yahweh of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”

paite: Hichi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Jerusalem kongzingte ah putekte leh pitekte ahong khosa ding ua, a-upat ziak un akhut uah chiangkhun akhun chiat ding uh.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.

paite: Khopi kongzingte a kimawl in numei leh pasal naupangte adim ding hi.
english: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' ToUPA'N achi: Huai ni chiang a hiai mite lak a khosuaksunte mit a lamdang ahihleh, kei mit ah leng alamdang sam kei dia hia? sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ngai in, suahlam gam a kipan leh tumlam gam a kipan, ka mite ka hondam ding hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.

paite: Amau ka hon pikhawm ding a, Jerusalem lai ah ateng ding ua; ka mite ahi ding uh, thutak leh diktatna ah, a Pathian uh ka hi ding hi.
english: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "TOUPA' inn suangphum phum ni a kipan a hiai nite a zawlneite kam a kipan a hiai thu zate'n, tempul akilam theihna ding in noute khut hatsak un.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahweh of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.

paite: Huai nite malam a mihing a dia kilohna a-om louh a, aganta dia leng kilohna a-om sam louh ziak in; melma ziak in apawtkhia hiam hong lut hiam a ding in leng muanna himhim a-omsak kei a, mi tengteng michih a-invengte dou in ka koih hi.
english: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.

paite: Himahleh tu in zaw hiai mite lak a khosuaksunte tung ah tuma lam nite bang in ka om kei ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huan haichi pawi a om ding ahi ngal a; grepgui in agah asuang ding a, leitung in apung a-omsak ding a, vante'n adaitui uh ape ding uh; huchi in hiai mite lak a omlaite hiai thil tengteng ka luahsak ding hi.
english: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, namte lak a hamsia na hih tak bang un, Aw Judah inkote leh Israel inkote, huchibang mah in nou ka hon hondam ding a; vualzawlna na hi ding uh; lau kei un, himahleh na khutte uh hatsak un."
english: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Na pipute un ahon hihheh lai ua, na tung ua gilou hih ding ka tup bang in, huchi in ka nem tuan kei, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi:
english: For Yahweh of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem tung leh Judah inkote tung ah hoih hih ding tulai nite in ka tum nawnta hi; lau kei un.
english: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.

paite: Na hih ding uh thil hiaite ahi: Michih in a-invengte toh thutak kihilh un; na kongpite uah thutak leh lemna vaihawmna hih un;
english: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,

paite: na lak ua kuamah in a-invengte siatna ding na lungtang uah gilou ngaihtuah kei un; thuchiam diklou deih kei un; hiaite tengteng ka thil huat lam ahi uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huan sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi,
heading: Namdangte'n TOUPA Azong Ding
english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Kha lina an ngawlna, ngana an ngawlna, sagihna an ngawlna leh sawmna an ngawlna, Judah inkote a ding in nopna leh kipahna, ankuangluina vualnopna ahi ding hi; huaiziak in thutak leh lemna deih in," chi in.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Hichibang in ahong om lai ding, mite leh khopi tampite a pan ahong pai ding ua;
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.

paite: huan, khopi khat a teng mite khopi dang a tengte kiang ah apai ding ua, TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding leh sepaihte' TOUPA zong ding in kintak in kuan ni; kei leng ka kuan ding, achi ding uhi.
english: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of Yahweh, and to seek Yahweh of Armies. I will go also.’

paite: Ahi, mi tampite leh nam hatte Jerusalem a TOUPA sepaihte zong ding leh TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding in ahong kuan ding uhi.
english: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek Yahweh of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of Yahweh.”

paite: Huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, namte pau tengteng a kipan mi sawm in Juda mipa puanten alen ding ua, na kiang ah ka pai ding uh, na kiang ah Pathian a-om chih ka za ngal ua, achi ding uh," chi in.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”
